reviews.text:
We entrusted our cat Vroum to Cécile for two weeks: I highly recommend ChatperlipoPet!

Cécile is very accommodating, patient, and reassuring.
A big thank you; we will definitely use this cattery again.

Cecile has a wonderful home away from home for cats. My two brother cats, one adult and one kitten, were happy as could be and she took wonderful care of them. There are many toys and things to climb on which helps the cats to make friends and have fun. Truly a gem in Lyon

Incredible experience! Loki stayed for three weeks at the cattery. Thanks to the very regular videos, we were quickly reassured! Our cat is very relaxed and playful in the videos and photos! Auntie took the time when we came to pick up our cat! We stayed for 45 minutes and saw him having fun with the other cats! This place is truly a paradise for cats!
Thank you so much for taking such good care of our little sweetheart! We will be back!
Loki's parents 🐾

From the very first visit, you feel a sense of well-being and serenity for your feline friends. My little Clingy (who's rather wary) stayed there for 14 days. I found her in great shape and not at all stressed. Cécile takes such good care of our furry friends, and a video showing them is posted every day. The cattery is remarkably clean and incredibly comfortable; there's even a television and sofa upstairs, and a whole host of engaging toys for the little guests! Personally, I'd compare it to a 5-star hotel for cats. I recommend it 300%! 👌 🐈

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I'm extremely happy with Chaperlipopet! I've been regularly boarding my cat Neko there for almost a year now, and this year, his little sister Miya joined him for her stays. 🐾❤️

Chaperlipopet is so much more than just a cat boarding facility: it's a clean, friendly, fun, and perfectly designed place for their well-being. My cats are safe, happy, and clearly feel right at home.

The place is quite surprising when you first see it: several living areas are set up to allow the cats to play, rest, explore, and live at their own pace. And a detail worth mentioning for a boarding facility that accommodates several cats: it smells wonderful! 😄 Everything is clean and perfectly maintained.

I really appreciate being able to follow their daily lives through the Instagram posts that Cécile regularly shares. We see them growing, playing, relaxing… and above all, we feel in every post all the love and care she has for them. It's incredibly reassuring when we have to leave our little companions for several days.

A huge thank you again to Cécile for taking such good care of our babies while we're away. ❤️

Absolute trust. I leave Neko and Miya with Chaperlipopet with complete peace of mind… and most importantly, we always come back with pleasure! 🐱🐱💕
Cats pampered and kept in perfect air conditioning! Thank you for taking such good care of Grandpa with a thousand little touches and such professionalism!

Another fantastic stay for our cat at Chaperlipopet boarding! We regularly entrust him to Cécile, whom we trust completely. The place is beautifully laid out and very clean. And we get daily updates thanks to her stories 🥰 …
A three-week stay during which everything went perfectly for our young cat: complete trust. Back home in great shape. Very reassuring to know our cat was well cared for and safe.

Our Paloma has been going to Cécile's boarding facility for 7 years now! The premises are very well equipped with plenty of perches and various toys.
Cécile is a very accommodating and attentive professional! (Thank you, Cécile!)

An incredible experience for our cat!
The Chaperlipopette team regularly updates us with messages and short videos about our little companion's stay.
Facilities worthy of a 5-star cat hotel 🐈‍⬛
Thank you 🤩

We just got our little Hermine back after she spent 17 days at Chatperlipopet! Thanks to Cécile, a welcoming, professional, and attentive cat host, everything went very well.
It was Hermine's first time being away from home for an extended period and meeting other cats, so naturally we were a little worried. Despite our apprehension, I must say that Cécile reassured us completely, and we felt we could trust her. This was all confirmed; we were able to watch the many videos taken daily and see Hermine's progress in this environment. She learned to live and play without stress with other cats, and that's really wonderful!
We will definitely let our kitten enjoy this lovely atmosphere regularly.
Thank you for everything.

Fantastic cat daycare! Shogun has been on multiple visits and loved it, and despite his shyness, he quickly warmed to the cuddles.

It allows us to leave with peace of mind, knowing he's well cared for (and kept cool during the summer).

A big thank you to Cécile, and see you next time :)
Sharly spent two perfect weeks of vacation at Cécile's, who welcomed him very warmly; he will gladly return.

When you entrust your cat to someone, you always hope to find a gem… and that's exactly what we found here! A huge thank you to Cécile for her wonderful welcome and true professionalism. Our dear Anouketh was pampered like a queen: we found her relaxed, happy, and clearly delighted with her "vacation." We leave with complete peace of mind for next time. Thank you again!

We are delighted to have entrusted our cat Chachou to Tata Cécile. She took excellent care of him, and everything is designed with the cats' well-being in mind at this superb cattery. I recommend Chaperlipopet 200%!

Amazing experience for Cookie! He was treated like royalty!

I highly recommend Chatperlipopet; it's an incredible place for cats. It's beautiful and very clean, and you can see that all the cats are happy to be there 😍

This is going to be my cat's vacation spot. Thanks again! ✨

Fantastic holiday camp for cats! I leave my Gueliz there with complete peace of mind, and for him, it's a holiday too!!!
I highly recommend it!

I entrusted my cat Haku to this cattery for over a month, from the beginning of May to the end of June, and I highly recommend it!

Living about an hour away, I made the trip to Lyon specifically for this cattery after discovering it on Google, and I absolutely don't regret my choice.

My initial contact with Cécile was quick, warm, and very professional. I particularly appreciated that she offered a trial stay before any booking. It's an excellent idea that allows you to check that your cat adapts well to its new environment and that everything will go smoothly.

Everything flowed seamlessly from start to finish: the communication, the explanations about how the cattery works, and the welcome. You can immediately tell that Cécile is passionate and knows cats very well.

I also greatly appreciated her presence on Instagram. Thanks to her regular stories, I was able to follow Haku's daily life without having to constantly ask for updates. It was a real joy to see him play, relax, explore his surroundings, and fully enjoy his stay surrounded by his feline friends.

I found Haku calm and clearly very well looked after during his entire absence. This is undoubtedly the best proof that he felt comfortable there.

I wholeheartedly recommend this boarding facility. If I ever need to board Haku again, I will return here with complete confidence. A huge thank you to Cécile for her kindness, availability, and all the attention she gives to our four-legged companions ❤️
Everything went perfectly with the cat sitting. I highly recommend them!

What a lovely holiday camp for Cookie, who's usually very stressed and seems to have adopted ChaperlipoPet' as his vacation spot, judging by the photos sent by "Auntie" Cécile.

A very pretty setting with everything our furry friends could want. Thank you, Cécile, for allowing me to enjoy these few days of peaceful vacation. Cookie says see you soon, and... me too! 🙂😻
Hi Cécile. Thank you so much. Our cat, Prince, loved your cattery, and having daily videos on Instagram is fantastic. It's reassuring and transparent for everyone. I highly recommend ChatperlipoPet'.

Top-notch cat boarding. Cecile is passionate and very attentive. She's also very accommodating. We did a two-day trial to test it out, and then we booked a vacation for our Patoune. Initially hesitant, she was won over by the place. It has to be said that between the TV and the air conditioning, the cats are spoiled rotten! Three different rooms are available, all with cat trees, toys, and plenty of perches where some are treated like royalty. Everything is very clean, and the cats seem very comfortable. Plus, several times a day, they post video stories on Facebook so we can see how things are going. What's more, our Patoune came back very sociable, whereas before she used to chase our other cat...

A huge thank you to Cécile and Chaterlipopet’ 🐾❤️
My cat has enjoyed several stays, both short and long, at this cattery in the heart of Lyon's 6th arrondissement. He's been going regularly since 2021. It's always a wonderful experience! From my very first interactions with Cécile, I sensed a deeply caring and passionate person. She truly takes care of each little guest as if they were her own.

I loved following the Instagram stories during his stay; it was such a joy to see my cat relaxed, pampered, and at ease 🥰 The spaces are clean, welcoming, and designed with cats' happiness in mind. Stays at Chaterlipopet’ aren't just a necessity when I'm away; they're also a fantastic opportunity for my cat to socialize with his friends, play, and have fun without any stress.

It's rare to find someone you can trust with your pet completely... and yet, that's exactly how I feel about Chaterlipopet'. A real little holiday camp for cats 😻

I left Akira at ChatperlipoPet' and honestly, it was a fantastic experience. Cécile is truly caring and passionate about animals; it's immediately apparent. The premises are clean and cat-friendly, and we receive regular updates, which is incredibly reassuring while we're away. My cat came back relaxed and in great shape, so I highly recommend them!
Thank you for welcoming my cats during several stays. They enjoyed being in your company. Thank you for your valuable advice.

A fantastic cat boarding facility! Plenty of equipment and toys available. Cécile is a professional, accommodating, and attentive to the well-being of the cats who come through her door. Alaska settled in immediately and loved it. She's been coming back every year since 2022. Thank you for her!

We've been entrusting our two cats, Ymir and Lucci, to Cécile for over a year now, and we're more than satisfied 😺 ChaperlipoPet' cattery offers them a play and rest area that's hard to find elsewhere. Everything is designed for their well-being and comfort, from the play area to the zen room. After several stays at the cattery, Cécile knows our cats' individual behaviors and needs perfectly, and we leave them in her care with complete confidence. Cécile is highly professional and always very accommodating. It's a real relief to know that our cats are so well cared for while we're away; we always leave with complete peace of mind. A nice bonus: the daily videos on the cattery's social media! It's a real pleasure to follow the adventures of our cats and their friends and see them moving about peacefully in the different areas the cattery offers. I highly recommend ChaperlipoPet' for entrusting your cats to a passionate professional who will take excellent care of your feline friends 😻

I've been entrusting my cats to the Chatperlipopet cattery for over a year now, and I couldn't be happier. They live there in complete freedom, surrounded by other cats, which gives them a real opportunity to socialize in a healthy and stimulating environment.

You can immediately tell that the animals' well-being is a priority for Cécile; the facilities are clean, well-suited, and designed with their comfort in mind. My cats are always relaxed and happy, which, for me, is the best indicator of trust.

It's a real relief to be able to leave knowing they're in good hands. I wholeheartedly recommend this cattery to all owners looking for a reliable, caring place that respects their companions' needs.

Ushy's first experience at a boarding kennel. It was wonderful!!!

A huge thank you to her new foster mom.
An incredible place, run by an equally incredible person!
We can follow our little pets' lives on Instagram, several times a day, and that's priceless.
10 days where Ushy got to live her best life!
She already wants to come back! ✨
Thank you 🙏 …

It was a real pleasure for me to leave my little darling with you for almost a week with complete peace of mind. He had a wonderful stay, especially since he usually loves being at home. The daycare is beautiful, with high-quality facilities and impeccable cleanliness. Thank you so much, Cécile, and I look forward to leaving my little man with you again!

Very clean. The place is air-conditioned and spacious with lots of toys. There's even a TV lounge with a sofa! 😻 Cécile takes excellent care of her furry friends! I entrust Pivoine to her with complete confidence and always find her in perfect health. …
I've been entrusting Miya to summer camp for 4 years now, everything is perfect, and Cecile is wonderful with Miya!!! 😍 …

ChatperlipoPet', voted the best cat boarding facility in the Universe 👑 (source: Kani 😸)

For over three years now, I've regularly taken my little Kani to stay at ChatperlipoPet', for about three to five weeks a year plus a few short weekends here and there. I entrust Kani to Cécile's capable care with complete peace of mind whenever I'm away; I can travel to the other side of the world without a worry!

Admittedly, the price might seem a bit high, but when I see the quality of the facilities (a veritable cat playground, there's something for everyone!), the frequent updates on social media, the cleanliness of the place, and Cécile's dedication to her little guests, the price seems perfectly reasonable. After all, we want the best for our furry friends, and with ChatperlipoPet' and its nearly 15 years of experience, you can't go wrong 😊

Thank you to Cécile for creating this cat paradise ✨
A few photos of Kani at the cattery 😻

I highly recommend this cattery. Cécile, the owner, is passionate about cats; it shows.

My little Maya has been staying there for several years now, and when I come to pick her up, she doesn't want to go home! ☺️ Special mention goes to the cleanliness and the atmosphere; everything is well thought out and tastefully decorated to ensure our furry friends have a wonderful stay.

My "little" Boris Attilio (a 5.5-month-old Siberian, but already 4 kg) had a blast at ChatperlipoPet'!

The atmosphere is very friendly, clean, and well-organized, truly tailor-made for cats.
The manager is super kind and attentive; everything went really well!
Thank you so much for your feedback and the beautiful photos of Nana 😻 …

What a joy it is for me to leave my O’Malley at this cattery!

For nine years now, he's loved seeing his friends there, and I've left him with Cecile with complete confidence (Berlioz has passed away, but he also really enjoyed his stays there 🙂).

The place is charming, very peaceful, and well-designed so that everyone has their own space and feels right at home.
Cecile loves our cats—her cats, really—and knows perfectly well how to meet their needs because she gets to know each one individually. That's why everyone gets along so well, and they also get a vacation when we're away.

Thank you, Cecile, for taking such good care of O’Malley once again; it's not always easy 😇

For the fourth year in a row, my little Safir spent his holidays at Chatperlipopet. And once again, what can I say? This boarding facility is truly unique, both in terms of its setting and comfort, the toys, the air conditioning, etc... simply the best of the best. How lucky we are to have this in Lyon! And what can I say about Cécile, the owner, without whom none of this would exist. A huge thank you to her for taking such loving care of our little pets. It's such a difficult job. :) Long live Chatperlipopet!
